## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest user-visible change that solves it.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] `resolve_scripts/Track Visualizer.lua` parses with `luaparser`
- [ ] Manual Resolve testing documented below, or not applicable
- [ ] Compatibility claims are limited to tested environments
- [ ] No generated binaries, private media, credentials, or diagnostic data are included
- [ ] User-visible changes are reflected in `CHANGELOG.md` and documentation

## Resolve Testing

List Resolve edition/version, operating system, steps, and result. Write `Not run` when no in-Resolve testing was performed.
